value.title: San Francisco deals with increasing graffiti, tagging to private properties - ABC7 San Francisco
value.excerpt: SAN FRANCISCO (KGO) -- If you think you've noticed more graffiti and tagging in San Francisco lately, you're not wrong. It has gotten worse. Graffiti is illegal and for a city that is trying to improve its image, it's going to take more than enforcement by police to get the city cleaned up.

value.title: S.F. anti-graffiti workers paint over the Valencia Art Wall
value.excerpt:
San Francisco’s graffiti abatement crew — intentionally, and perhaps only temporarily — painted over the Art Wall at the former Mission District police station that, for more than 20 years, has been a destination for hundreds of artists and amateurs.
